create_decoder_config: create a DecoderConfig dataclass instance to select viterbi, kenlm, or fairseqlm decoder type
create_flashlight_decoder_config: create a FlashlightDecoderConfig dataclass instance to configure beam search and language model decoding parameters
configure_decoder_type: configure the DecoderConfig type field to choose between viterbi, kenlm, or fairseqlm decoder strategies
configure_beam_search: configure FlashlightDecoderConfig beam size and beam threshold for speech recognition beam search decoding
configure_language_model_weights: configure FlashlightDecoderConfig lmweight, wordscore, unkweight, and silweight for KenLM language model interpolation
